Happy Birthday Adebanks

Oluwatosin Christiana Adebiyi

Dear Adebanks,

I don't think I say it enough, so today I'm saying it properly: thank you for being the kind of friend I didn't know I could have.

We haven't even been in the same room yet, and somehow you've shown up for me more than people I've known for years. You make hard days lighter and good days louder, and you make me feel like I'm never doing life alone.

Your kindness is real. Your energy is contagious. The way you treat people makes the world feel a little softer, and I notice it every time.

So here is my wish for you this birthday: all the joy you give away, coming back to you double. Rest well, laugh loudly, and let people spoil you today.

Happy Birthday, Adebanks. I'm so grateful to be one of the people cheering for you.

With all my love,
Dexter
